en:
According to my calculations, not everyone
has gathered today.

You can see that without doing
any calculations...
Geez, what's everyone else doing?

It seems Maki has chosen to spend all her time
inside her <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I am not sure what she is doing in there,
but she has no intention of leaving.

What does the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL> gotta
do in her research lab anyway?

Maybe she's hiding a bunch of kids in there
that she's secretly taking care of!

What? She's not some stray dog
on the streets raising pups...

I also saw Kokichi and Gonta sneaking
around together.

A couple of virgins sneakin' around sounds
like bad news to me!

Ah, I saw Ryoma on my way here, but
he said he wasn't coming today...

I see... Well, we don't need that guy around 
here till he's got his head on straight.

Tch... How did <CLT=cltSTRONG>the famous<CLT=cltNORMAL> Ryoma Hoshi
end up like that!?

<CLT=cltMIND>What?
<CLT=cltSTRONG>"The famous"<CLT=cltMIND> Ryoma Hoshi...?
Moving along...

What...are those two doing?
What is that?
Hey, bro! Did you sleep well last night?

Ah, yeah! Really, thank you, Kaito.
My muscles are still sore...
That's what I thought! You look refreshed!

Huh? Did you call Shuichi your bro?
When did you two become bros?

It's no big deal!
I'm just training Shuichi is all.

A bromance!? Gross! I guess virgins are
just magnets for each other!

N-No... It's not like they're using a
stand or anything.

So...what are Himiko and Angie doing?
Are they praying?
How did the conversation end up here?

Geez, girls' conversations are always like this.
They jump around so much, I can't keep up.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's not really important
right now, Kaito...

This is rather strange...Angie is the same as 
ever, but it seems Himiko is praying too.
Whatever could be going on?

Kehehe... That is some impressive 
brainwashing, indeed.

It seems being the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Artist<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is not Angie's only talent.

Himiko is acting rather odd. I do not fully
understand what she is doing...
What's going on...?
Did Angie...do something to Himiko?
Hm? I just undid her brainwashing, that's all.
But...Himiko is clearly acting strange.

That's rude. I'm not acting strange.
This is my true self...
I guess Atua's words can't reach robots...
Wha—! You're being robophobic again!

It's okay! Atua has compassion for robots
who look human!
O-Okay...

Himiko is obviously acting strange.
What did Angie do to her?

Neither of us has exchanged our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>
with another, correct?

As long as murder remains a possibility, we
must not watch those videos.
I see you agree with us, Kirumi.

It's rare I hear you speak your opinion 
like that.
I do so to safeguard Kaede's final request.

Her request was that we all live, and I believe
this course of action will fulfill that request.

There is no shame in choosing to retreat for
the sake of one's survival.

There is no shame in choosing to retreat for
the sake of one's survival.
A divine message...

I think it would be best to verify what her
Atua has to say...

I have a handsome god...
A handsome god is watching over me...
So I don't need to be scared of anything...

D-Don't say that! That's a super huge 
death flag!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Death flag?

What's Angie doing with Himiko...?
What's going on...?
U-Um, I mean, I'm not jealous or anything!

My feelings for Himiko are totally clean
and pure!

Not like you degenerate males and your
filthy, vulgar, impure feelings!

Maki's just been holed up in her 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>, hasn't she?

Is it such a great lab that she just got 
absorbed in it?

But...I can't even imagine what sort of things
would be in a lab for child caregivers...
It can't be children, but...

Becoming a mom in her first year of 
high school...that's just unthinkable.

Oh no... It's like she's fallen into a cult,
isn't it?

To think that Himiko, who calls herself
a mage, ended up like this...

Or wait... Do you need to have a patron
deity to use magic?

Or is that just for divine spells?
Himiko seems more like the black magic type.

You'd need a demon for that. Well, if you
believe in demons, you believe in gods too, right?

Oh, sorry. All of that is just plain 
unimportant. I was just curious...

More importantly...wouldn't it be better if we
could hear Angie's divine messages too?

Angie...
What are these "divine messages"?

Atua says that this academy suffers from
the same sins as the outside world.

You're all unhappy cuz your greed is making
you treat each other like adversaries.

Atua has spoken... Your desire to leave this
place is only worsening your <CLT=cltSTRONG>greed<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Greed?

So we must cast aside that sinful greed,
and rejoice in our new lives here.

You... So you are saying we should live 
here for the rest of our lives?
No, noooo, that's wrong.

It's not enough to simply live here forever.
Our lives must also be full of divine purpose.
In other words...
We must make this academy heaven on earth!
<CLT=cltMIND>What...?

In doing so...our desire to leave will vanish,
and the killings will cease.
Are you...being serious right now?

This place provides us all with shelter, food,
clothing, and wonderful friends!

What more could you possibly desire?
Do not give in to your greed.
Wh-What!?

Himiko, do you hear this nonsense!?
Snap out of it!
Atua's divine messages are never wrong.
What?
Himiko is a good girl and a fast learner.
Together, we devised a truly divine plan.

Nyahahaha! The best plan ever to help us live
lives of fulfillment here!
The best plan?
Tell them, Himiko.
Make them burst with happiness.

Nyeeeh, explode with excitement!
It's finally happening...

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Amazing Himiko's Magic Show<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is finally opening!
A magic show...?

Don't worry, admission is free. Er, actually, 
I guess admission will just be your smiles.
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Over the years, my show has given many
smiles to people with broken hearts...
Now is the time to demonstrate my powers.

My magic is the only thing that can 
heal your twisted hearts.

But in our current predicament, performing
magic tricks is quite illogical—

Nyeeeh, don't disturb my concentration.
You gotta learn to read the mood already.

And...it's called a magic show cuz I do magic. 
Not tricks.

S-Screw your magic show. I don't get
excited about that crap.
You're way too excited!

Nyeeeh, the show opens <CLT=cltSTRONG>tomorrow morning<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Come
to the gym after the morning announcement.

You guys better get excited and look
forward to it with antisterbation!

Surely you mean "anticipation"? Or have 
I misunderstood the nature of this show...?

Himiko and I will begin the prepwork, and I'm
supposed to ask others to help, too...

I'm counting on you guys to help.
Nyahahaha, bye-onara!
Nyeeeh...farewell.

<CLT=cltMIND>After announcing their show before anyone could
react, Himiko and Angie left the dining hall.
H-Himiko... What happened to her...?

Kehehe... Faith as intense as this
can be quite terrifying.

There may be no cause for concern. This does
not appear to be related to our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
You're only worried about that?

Of course. We cannot afford to take
Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL> lightly.

But...everyone who isn't here could be 
showing each other their videos, right?
You mean Kokichi, Gonta, and Ryoma!?
No...I don't think that's it.

Even with three people, there's a low probability
of them having each other's motive videos.

It seems unlikely that one of them would show
a motive video without seeing their own in return.

So I don't think a video exchange in a
small group like that is likely.
I see... That is true.

Heh, not bad!
That's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> for you!
Ah, y-yeah...

I guess we'll just have to wait and see what
happens. The same goes for Angie and Himiko.
Arghhh...! G-Give...Himiko back...!

For now, let us have some breakfast, shall
we? I have prepared meals for everyone.

Of course, I will deliver meals to those who
are not currently present.

You don't gotta do that!
I'll eat their portions!
Oooooaaaaahhhhhh!!!
Kaito! Don't push yourself too hard...

<CLT=cltMIND>After I helped the stuffed Kaito to his
room, I returned to my own.
What are Kokichi and Gonta up to?

Omigod! Did those virgins finally get so
pent up that they turned on each other!?
This is bad! They're gonna get so addicted!

A virgin is weakest during their first time!
It doesn't take much to get 'em off!

<CLT=cltMIND>Just like Tenko said...
Himiko and Angie were acting weird.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably best to ask them
about it directly.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."

<CLT=cltMIND>Just like Tenko said...
Himiko and Angie were acting weird.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably best to ask them
about it directly.
